newsitem.title: UK: Syria lifts August Souedie crude price 45 cents.
newsitem.headline: Syria lifts August Souedie crude price 45 cents.

text.p: Syrian state oil company Sytrol and term contract holders have agreed a higher price for August barrels of the producer's heavy Souedie crude, traders said on Tuesday.
August Souedie will be priced at Dated Brent -$3.90 a barrel, up 45 cents from July's level.

Despite stiff resistance from lifters, Sytrol pointed to a 55-cent increase in the price of August Arab Heavy and strong seasonal demand for bitumen-rich crudes to justify the increase, the traders said.
Last week, Sytrol and its customers also settled on a higher price for cargoes of Syrian Light crude loading in August.
Syrian Light will cost Dated Brent -45 cents a barrel, 10 cents firmer than in July.
